messages:
Maya S: Quick thread for the mini GPTQ cross-family smoke run. Ran Llama / Mistral / Qwen through the GPTQ recipe (per-family calib, 128 examples) — dropping highlights.

Alex T: Nice. what's the eval set and main metric? noref or task accuracy?

Maya S: Multi-domain promptset: summarization (ROUGE-L), instruction SxS accuracy, and MMLU-style probes. Primary gating is SxS accuracy + median token perf.

Chen L: Quick result table paste:
```
Model                | FP16 perf | GPTQ-8 perf | Delta
Llama-2-13B          | 78.3      | 76.1        | -2.2
Mistral-7B-Instruct  | 72.0      | 71.4        | -0.6
Qwen-7B-Chat         | 75.5      | 73.8        | -1.7
```

Diego R: Mistral held up best on GPTQ-8. Latency improved ~18% on our p3 racks — makes it a strong candidate for dedicated pools.

Maya S: Any weird instruction-following regressions or hallucination patterns?

Chen L: Pattern to flag: Llama GPTQ-8 shows token-level drift after ~1024 tokens (KV mismatch). Repro steps attached in the eval run — looks tied to layernorm quant rounding.

Maya S: Ops suggestion: canary rollout 5% to GPTQ variants with automatic fallback to FP16 if accuracy delta > 1.5% over a 1h window.

ops-bot: Noted — created rollout ticket INF-4213 and alert rule (slo: accuracy delta > 1.5% over 1h) :white_check_mark:

Alex T: Important callout: treat AWQ vs GPTQ differently. AWQ reduced peak memory more but exhibited worse long-KV stability in our runs.

Diego R: Agree. Recommendation: use GPTQ for Mistral routes where latency/cost is primary; keep Llama-13B on FP16 or AWQ at low traffic until KV layernorm fix lands.

Maya S: I'll assemble per-route configs + rollback criteria for the console. Thanks all :heart:

ci-bot: CI summary: gptq-smoke — 18/20 checks passed, 2 flaky tests (kv-cache-integration). Logs: /ci/artifacts/3067890123/gptq-smoke.log

Chen L: Filing follow-up issue on layernorm quantization math + minimal testcases.

Alex T: :thumbsup:
